description_en: Queries the notification settings for task flows
description_zh: 调用GetTaskFlowNotification接口，获取任务流通知设置
name: GetTaskFlowNotification

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Notification.description_en: The notification settings specified by the user
Notification.description_zh: 用户指定消息通知配置

DagNotificationFail.description_en:
Indicates whether notifications for failed task flows are enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
DagNotificationFail.description_zh:
任务流运行失败通知开关。返回值说明如下：
true：开启。
false：关闭

DagNotificationSla.description_en:
Indicates whether service level agreement (SLA) global notifications for task flows are enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
DagNotificationSla.description_zh:
任务流SLA通知全局开关。返回值说明如下：
true：开启。
false：关闭

DagNotificationSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether notifications for successful task flows are enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
DagNotificationSuccess.description_zh:
任务流运行成功通知开关。返回值说明如下：
true：开启。
false：关闭

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值说明如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
